pages.text: Mowzie's Mobs fills the world with fictional creatures built around unique AI, rich atmosphere, and fluid animations. Each boss guards their own biome and drops an ability you can claim as your own. Mid-game tier — harder than vanilla, softer than Bosses' Rise.$(br2)$(bold)Ferrous Wroughtnaut$() — Underground iron giant. Slow, cleaving, extremely tanky. Has a damage-type weakness — figure it out and the fight opens up. Drops Wroughtnaut's Axe.

$(bold)Frostmaw$() — Snowy biomes. Massive, high HP, ice breath. A war of attrition. Drops the Ice Crystal — a melee weapon that applies frost slowness on hit.$(br2)$(bold)Naga$() — Jungle underground lair. Fast, venomous, aggressive. Drops the Fang Dagger with built-in poison proc.

$(bold)Barako, the Sun Chief$() — Savanna or Plains. Summons followers and commands with magic. Defeat him and claim the $(bold)Sol Visage$() — a mask that lets you summon your own warriors.$(br2)$(bold)General:$() Mowzie's structures blend into their biomes. Scout before engaging — the mobs inside are not passive, and their boss hits significantly harder than vanilla tier.
